convert_detectron_model_to_pb: run the script to convert a trained detectron model from pkl format to Caffe2 pb format for production deployment
run_model_pb_inference: run the converted pb model on a test image and fetch detection scores, boxes, and class IDs
verify_model_conversion: verify the converted pb model produces identical results to the original detectron cfg model on a test image
convert_python_ops_to_cpp: convert Python operators like GenerateProposalsOp and CollectAndDistributeFpnRpnProposalsOp to their C++ equivalents in the Caffe2 net
export_model_to_logfiledb: export the converted Caffe2 model to a logfiledb format instead of standard pb files for mobile deployment
